instruction_sequence.comparison: The only opcode differences are register allocation/order changes in the default ghost-config block; stores, constants and subsequent dataflow match.

branch_contract.allocation_failure: logs the allocation failure and returns -ENOMEM
branch_contract.optional_dt_properties: presence and read failures preserve the observed defaults and field offsets
branch_contract.proc_sysfs_failures: logs individual creation failures while preserving the stock continuation behavior
branch_contract.success: initializes delayed work, timestamps, waitqueue and zlog fields, logs probe completion and returns zero

relocation_normalization.reason: Both functions expose 385 relocations and identical call/property structure; separately linked local .rodata/.rodata pointer offsets and symbol layout differ.

limitations: Raw ELF relocation and instruction-byte identity is not exact across independently linked modules.
The host harness stubs kernel allocators, Device Tree, procfs/sysfs, mutex, workqueue and platform behavior.
Alignment sanitization is disabled in the host ABI model because the recovered source contains intentional raw offset stores.
No smartphone, scheduler, platform bus or physical hardware was used.
